The Future of the Energy–AI Nexus: How can AI accelerate a just energy transition by scaling finance and innovation?

Today at the 2025 Global Energy Interconnection Conference in Beijing, I will be hosting, alongside colleagues from @GEIDCO, a high-level dialogue on the future of the Energy–AI nexus. We’ll explore how AI can reshape sustainable energy – making projects more bankable, attracting finance and broadening access to clean power.

I will be joined by @Chen Ying, @Yuncheng Xu, @Peng Yijie, @Saifur Rahman, @Jerry Lou, and @Dennis She. Together, we will explore how AI can help turn ideas into bankable projects, attract private finance, and scale clean energy access in ways that drive equity and innovation.

By 2050, many emerging markets will face higher capital costs and limited technical capacity. The key question is: how can we take full advantage of the transformative opportunities of AI in the just energy transition, in order to scale up finance and innovation for impact where it is needed most?

📅 Wednesday, 10 September 2025
⏰ 09:00–10:30 (CST)
📍 Beijing National Convention Center
